title: LCD154: hold the battery power latch; flasher uses a watchdog reset
head: fix/lcd154-power-latch-and-flasher-reset
body:
Fixes the Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-LCD-1.54 board that flashed fine but booted dark and died when USB was unplugged. Measured on the bench and read off the schematic (`ESP32-S3-LCD-1.54-Schematic.pdf`) on 2026-09-22 — the board is not damaged.

## 1. Battery power is a soft latch the firmware must hold
- VBAT → P-FET **Q2** → VSYS. Q2's gate is pulled to VBAT (off) by R23.
- **PWR** pulls the gate low through D5 only while pressed; the same press reaches **GPIO5** through D3.
- **GPIO2** (net `BAT_EN`) → T1 (8050) → keeps Q2 on. Nothing else does. USB feeds VSYS through Q3 regardless.
- The firmware never drove GPIO2, so it ran on USB and switched off the moment the cable came out.

`firmware/main/main.c`: under `#ifdef PIN_BAT_EN` (only defined in the LCD154 block of `board_pins.h`), GPIO2 is driven high first thing in `app_main`. `board_pins.h`: the wrong "PWR is not wired to the ESP32" comment replaced with the schematic; `PIN_BAT_EN 2`, `PIN_BTN_PWR 5` added.

## 2. The flasher's reset parks this board in ROM download mode
No USB bridge chip on this board — the cable is on the S3's native USB-Serial-JTAG. esptool's default `hard_reset` and `read_log()`'s own RTS/DTR pulse both land the ROM in download mode (strap register reads GPIO0 low, `waiting for download`): screen dark, no log, port still enumerated — the exact "flashes fine, never comes on, nothing in the log" symptom. A watchdog reset is a real chip reset with the pins left alone, and the port stays up across it.

`tools/upgrade/pocket_tank_upgrade.py`: for `picked["id"] == "lcd154"`, `--after watchdog_reset` (esptool 4.8.1, as pinned) and `read_log(..., reset=False)`.

## AMOLED
Untouched: every change is behind the LCD154 board config or board id. The AMOLED build compiles to the same binary and its upgrader path is identical.

## Verified on the bench
- Chip/eFuses fine (no secure boot / encryption, USB not disabled); flash holds valid bootloader, partition table and app.
- After an RTS/DTR reset: ROM download mode, `boot:0x0`. After a watchdog reset: app boots — touch, IMU, codec, display 15.8 fps, battery 98% / 4150 mV.
- Cold plug-in boots the app; unplugging USB powers off (the latch, item 1).

## To flash
Run the `upgrader-lcd154` workflow (workflow_dispatch) on this branch and use the `PocketTankUpgrade-LCD154.exe` artifact.
